macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Hot U.S. inflation drives stock-market selloff
items.summary: U.S. consumer inflation rose 3.7% year over year in September, above expectations, while the S&P 500 fell 1.10%, the Nasdaq Composite dropped 1.88%, and the Dow declined 0.09%.

items.title: Producer prices surge; retail sales beat forecasts
items.summary: U.S. producer prices increased 1.3% month over month and 6.3% year over year in September, the largest monthly rise since 2022. Retail sales also advanced 0.8%, exceeding expectations and reinforcing concerns that the Federal Reserve may keep policy restrictive.

items.title: Fed rate-hike expectations increase
items.summary: Market pricing showed a higher probability of a Federal Reserve rate increase at the October meeting and stronger expectations for a December hike after the inflation data. San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said further increases could be needed but that immediate action was not necessary.

items.title: Bank earnings produce mixed market reaction
items.summary: Morgan Stanley and BlackRock reported better-than-expected quarterly results, but their shares moved in opposite directions. Bank of America missed revenue and earnings expectations, sending its stock down sharply.

items.title: AI and semiconductor shares remain under pressure
items.summary: Technology, semiconductor, and AI-related stocks led the market decline as investors reassessed valuations and interest-rate risks. Taiwan Semiconductor shares fell despite a quarterly profit beat after its gross margin missed forecasts.

items.title: China trade surplus expands
items.summary: China’s trade surplus increased to $133.53 billion in September from $119.09 billion in August, substantially exceeding economists’ forecasts.

items.title: GlobalFoundries announces major U.S. semiconductor investment
items.summary: GlobalFoundries is set to invest $21 billion in two semiconductor manufacturing facilities in Malta, New York, with financing linked to a previously reached trade agreement.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies fall as hot inflation triggers risk-off selling
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $80,800, down about 3.8% in 24 hours, while Ether fell 6.6%, Solana 6.0%, XRP 5.9% and BNB 4.3%. Total crypto market capitalization dropped roughly 2.7% as hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation and a sharp South Korean stock-market decline pressured risk assets.

items.title: Nearly $1 billion in leveraged crypto positions liquidated
items.summary: About $1 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, with long positions accounting for most of the forced closures. Ether long liquidations on Binance exceeded $106 million in one hour, reportedly the exchange’s largest such episode in six months.

items.title: EU designates USDC a significant e-money token under MiCA
items.summary: The European Banking Authority designated Circle’s USDC as the first significant e-money token under the EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets framework. The designation brings greater reserve, liquidity and supervisory requirements for large stablecoins.

items.title: Standard Chartered expands crypto trading in the UAE
items.summary: Standard Chartered received authorization from Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority to offer Bitcoin and Ether trading to professional investors in the United Arab Emirates.

items.title: Solana Alpenglow mainnet launch remains scheduled for October 21
items.summary: Solana’s Alpenglow upgrade is still scheduled to reach mainnet on October 21, even as SOL declined about 6% during the broader market sell-off.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Brazil expands cultural support for game development
items.summary: Brazil’s government regulated its legal framework for electronic games, recognizing video games as audiovisual and cultural products. The measure opens access to public funding, creates a platform for Brazilian games, and includes startup support and expanded university education initiatives.

items.title: Valor Mortis launches on PC and current-gen consoles
items.summary: One More Level, the studio behind Ghostrunner, released its new action game Valor Mortis on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The game is also joining the Game Pass catalog.

items.title: Machinarium 2 announced
items.summary: Amanita Design announced Machinarium 2 during the Triple-i Initiative presentation. The adventure game does not yet have a release date, but a Steam page is available.

items.title: Forza Horizon 6 dated for PlayStation 5
items.summary: Xbox Game Studios and Playground Games announced that Forza Horizon 6 will launch on PlayStation 5 on January 26, 2027, alongside its first expansion and a free update.

items.title: Microsoft creates new Xbox XP division amid restructuring
items.summary: Microsoft announced a new internal Xbox division called XP. The move comes amid another round of layoffs and reports that Ninja Theory could face closure.

items.title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival released
items.summary: Saber Interactive released the horror game Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival, with review coverage also going live.

items.title: Ubisoft considers cuts at three German studios
items.summary: Ubisoft reportedly plans a voluntary departure program affecting approximately 100 employees across its Düsseldorf, Berlin, and Mainz studios as it seeks to reposition its German operations.

items.title: Google unveils generative-AI game creation platform
items.summary: Google introduced Playground, an experimental browser-based platform designed to let users create simple games with generative artificial intelligence.
